page.overview:
Who is Stormfeather?

Stormfeather is a male background Pegasus pony with a bluish gray coat, light yellow mane and tail, bluish gray eyes, and a cutie mark of a shooting star. He is unnamed in the series, but he is named in other media.

Stormfeather shares his design with "Silver Script" and "Cool Beans", his mane and tail style with "Chocolate Haze", "Klein", Emerald Green, "Written Script", Comet Tail, Rare Find, "Brass Blare", Bright Bulb, and S04E22 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #3, and his color scheme with "Cloud Break".

Stormfeather appears in the crowd outside the Golden Oak Library complaining to Twilight Sparkle about Pinkie Pie's clones in Too Many Pinkie Pies. In Wonderbolts Academy, Stormfeather appears as a Wonderbolts cadet and lead pony to Pizzelle. He also appears in Rainbow Dash's flashback at the beginning of Games Ponies Play.

Stormfeather briefly appears watching Soarin fall out of the sky in Rainbow Falls, watches the goof-off between Pinkie Pie and Cheese Sandwich in Pinkie Pride, and has his magic stolen by Lord Tirek in Twilight's Kingdom - Part 1.
